concept.title: Software Updates
concept.shortdesc: Learn why installing updates right away keeps your devices as well as your university data safe.

conbody.p: Software updates fix problems in your operating system, apps, and web browser. Many updates fix issues such as security flaws, so installing them as soon as possible is one of the simplest ways to protect your devices and the university data you work with.

section.title: Why Updates Matter
section.p: Updates include security fixes for the newest kinds of attacks. Every day you put off an update, your device stays vulnerable.

note.p: Turn on automatic updates wherever your device offers them, and install updates right when you see a notification.

p.xref: To install updates, see Install software updates.

section.title: University-owned and Personal Devices
section.p: Who installs updates depends on the device.
On a computer owned by the university, your local IT staff may install updates for you. You may still need to restart your computer to finish installing them.
On your personal device like your phone, tablet, or computer, you are responsible for installing updates yourself.
